name: Quarterly review deck
pitch: Creates an outline for a quarterly business review from calendar events and email threads.
instructions: Start by listing the calendar events for the last quarter using calendar_list. Then list the person's mail threads using mail_list. For each thread found, read it with mail_read to extract key decisions, achievements and blockers. If a tool returns no items, say so and stop that step. After gathering the material, make_page a new document titled "Quarterly Review Outline" with sections for: summary of key events, major achievements, pending items, and next steps. Populate each section with bullet points drawn from the collected data. If data is missing for a section, write "Not found" for that section. At the end, show the person the outline and ask if they want to add or remove any points.
starters: draft a deck from my calendar and email

examples.does: lists calendar events and reads recent emails to build an outline

readme:
# Quarterly review deck
Creates an outline for a quarterly business review from calendar events and email threads.

What it does: pulls events from the calendar and threads from mail, extracts key points, and makes a page with a structured outline.
What it needs: calendar and mail connectors; calendar_list, mail_list, mail_read, make_page tools.
What it will not do: it will not write full slides, it will not grade performance, and it will not send the outline anywhere without the person's say-so.
